package.description: A music player that respects what's yours.

en-US.description: A music player that respects what's yours.
en-US.longDescription:
Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
en-US.name: Noctis
en-US.releaseNotes:
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.6.8-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed songs never moving up the Plays sort after being played last
- Fixed Similar Artists not updating after Search Artist Info
- Fixed full-screen lyrics showing the sidebar on Windows and Linux
- Fixed gaps and crunch at damaged spots in long MP3s
- Fixed slow album scrolling with large covers
- Fixed phone card switches lagging when toggled
- Fixed Advanced arrow doing nothing when clicked
- Fixed artwork popup tooltips being hidden or clipped
- Fixed hovered covers zooming and getting cut off
- Fixed taskbar icon not changing after picking a new App Icon
- Fixed about 300 hard-coded English texts not translating
- Fixed Songs summary line and cut-off column headers
- Fixed two wrong Spanish words
- Fixed lyrics page going blank when every provider was off
- Fixed Share Lyrics doing nothing on songs marked as having no lyrics
- Fixed playlist header showing only search matches instead of the whole playlist
- Fixed covers vanishing after moving the data folder
- Fixed moving one song taking the album's animated cover with it
- Fixed .dff tags not loading
- Fixed misleading error when saving tags on a .dff file
- Fixed closing one menu animating another closed
- Fixed cache usage stuck at 0 B
- Fixed missing status while preparing a data folder move
- Fixed Search Lyrics scrollbar overlapping the cards
- Fixed Repeat All after clearing the queue mid-album jumping to the album's first song
- Fixed Shuffle off after a clear bringing back old tracks
- Fixed Last.fm scrobbling stopping after an offline startup
- Fixed saved album list being reused after songs moved to another album
- Fixed tag re-reads not recording whether the album artist was real
- Fixed Group into One Album not writing tags to songs already grouped automatically
- Fixed Albums page keeping hidden albums selected after a library reload
- Fixed exported playlists writing broken paths for server and phone songs
- Fixed a playlist's Featured Artists shrinking after removing a song during a search
Added
- Added Data Folder setting to move the library, covers and caches to another drive
- Added animated artwork search when opening an album
- Added cache size limit and usage bar for animated artwork
- Added Remove Animated Artwork to the album menu
- Added animated artwork removal when an album is removed
- Added centred player layout for songs with no lyrics
- Added Search Lyrics button in the player island
- Added Settings toggle for the no-lyrics layout
- Added DSD playback for .dsf and .dff files
- Added Hi-Res badge for DSD files
- Added DSD64, DSD128 and DSD256 output in Convert
- Added Export Playlist to .m3u8 in the playlist menu
- Added Liquid Glass to every menu, submenu, tooltip and drop-down
- Added German language
- Added download speed and time left for plugin and YouTube downloads
- Added Clear Queue that also removes the playing song
- Added Last.fm mixes on Home from your own songs
- Added Discover on Last.fm for artists and albums you don't have
- Added Mixes and Recommendations toggle
- Added automatic album grouping for songs with the same album name in one folder
- Added Group into One Album action
Improved
- Improved long MP3 handling by finding damage ahead of time
- Improved cache saving speed for large covers
- Improved fewer covers loading at once in album views
- Improved Advanced arrow and phone card switch responsiveness
- Improved translations across all 11 languages
- Improved Settings descriptions for Animated Artwork and Data Folder
- Improved Artwork and Animated Artwork search into one design with a search box
- Improved Albums Grid view to grey out unavailable cover styles with a tooltip
- Improved Clear button to work when only the playing song is left
- Improved Group, Move to folder and Rename folder pop-ups design
- Improved Group messages to show a single OK button
Full Changelog: v1.6.7...v1.6.8
